name: 106B - Core - Tool Router - Final Patient Operations V5

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS message_id
),

routing_context AS (
    SELECT
        session.id AS session_id,
        session.clinic_id,
        session.patient_id,
        session.channel,
        session.external_conversation_id,
        session.language,
        session.status AS session_status,
        session.last_intent,
        session.pending_action,
        session.collected_entities,
        session.risk_flags AS session_risk_flags,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        message.id AS message_id,
        message.content_text,
        message.content_json,
        message.intent,
        message.intent_confidence,
        message.extracted_entities,
        message.risk_flags AS message_risk_flags,
        message.tool_action,
        message.tool_result,

        message.tool_result -> 'safety'
            AS safety_payload

    FROM request_data request

    INNER JOIN conversation_sessions session
        ON session.id = request.session_id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = session.clinic_id

    LEFT JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = session.patient_id

    INNER JOIN conversation_messages message
        ON message.id = request.message_id
       AND message.session_id = session.id
       AND message.direction = 'inbound'

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM routing_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM routing_context
            WHERE safety_payload IS NULL
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM routing_context
        )
            THEN 'message_or_session_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM routing_context
            WHERE safety_payload IS NULL
        )
            THEN 'safety_decision_not_found'

        ELSE 'tool_routing_context_loaded'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT ROW_TO_JSON(routing_context)
        FROM routing_context
    ) AS routing_context

FROM request_data request;

parameters.jsCode:
if ($json.success !== true) {
  return [{ json: $json }];
}

const ctx = $json.routing_context || {};
const safety = ctx.safety_payload || {};
const entities = (
  ctx.collected_entities &&
  typeof ctx.collected_entities === 'object'
    ? ctx.collected_entities
    : {}
);

const currentEntities = (
  ctx.extracted_entities &&
  typeof ctx.extracted_entities === 'object'
    ? ctx.extracted_entities
    : {}
);

const all = { ...entities, ...currentEntities };

const text = (value) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
  return String(value).trim();
};

const numberOrZero = (value) => {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isInteger(number) && number > 0
    ? number
    : 0;
};

const isIsoDate = (value) => {
  const str = text(value);
  return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str);
};

const isTime = (value) => {
  const str = text(value);
  return /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(str);
};

const safetyDecision = text(safety.safety_decision);
const safeToolAction = text(
  safety.safe_tool_action || ctx.tool_action || 'none'
);

const common = {
  clinic_name: ctx.clinic_name,
  mobile: text(all.mobile || ctx.mobile),
  source_channel: ctx.channel === 'webchat'
    ? 'web'
    : ctx.channel,
};

const dateValue = text(
  all.target_date ||
  all.new_target_date ||
  all.date ||
  all.date_text
);

const timeValue = text(
  all.start_time ||
  all.new_start_time ||

  all.time_text
);

      recovery_status: text(all.recovery_status),
      pain_level:
        Number.isInteger(Number(all.pain_level))
          ? Number(all.pain_level)
          : -1,
      has_red_flag:
        Boolean(all.has_red_flag),
      red_flag_details:
        text(all.red_flag_details),
      has_medication_issue:
        Boolean(all.has_medication_issue),
      medication_issue_details:
        text(all.medication_issue_details),
      has_complaint:
        Boolean(all.has_complaint),
      complaint_details:
        text(all.complaint_details),
      satisfaction_score:
        Number.isInteger(Number(all.satisfaction_score))
          ? Number(all.satisfaction_score)
          : 0,
      patient_comment:
        text(
          all.patient_comment ||
          ctx.content_text
        ),
      confirm_response: true,
    },
    required: [
      'followup_token',
      'mobile',
      'recovery_status',
      'pain_level',
      'satisfaction_score',
      ...(Boolean(all.has_red_flag)
        ? ['red_flag_details']
        : []),
      ...(Boolean(all.has_medication_issue)
        ? ['medication_issue_details']
        : []),
      ...(Boolean(all.has_complaint)
        ? ['complaint_details']
        : []),
    ],
    allow_zero_fields: [
      'pain_level',
    ],
  },

  process_disruption_patient_decision: {
    workflow_number: 21,
    workflow_name:
      '21 - API - Process Disruption Patient Decision - Standalone Final',
    endpoint:
      'clinic/disruptions/process-patient-decision',
    method: 'POST',
    payload: {
      disruption_case_id:
        numberOrZero(all.disruption_case_id),
      mobile: common.mobile,
      decision: text(
        all.disruption_decision ||
        all.patient_decision
      ),
      option_number:
        numberOrZero(all.option_number),
      decision_note: text(
        all.decision_note ||
        ctx.content_text
      ),
      options_per_patient:
        Number.isInteger(
          Number(all.options_per_patient)
        )
          ? Number(all.options_per_patient)
          : 3,
      additional_search_days:
        Number.isInteger(
          Number(all.additional_search_days)
        )
          ? Number(all.additional_search_days)
          : 14,
      confirm_decision: true,
    },
    required: [
      'disruption_case_id',
      'mobile',
      'decision',
      ...(
        text(
          all.disruption_decision ||
          all.patient_decision
        ) === 'reschedule'
          ? ['option_number']
          : []
      ),
    ],
  },

  urgent_human_handoff: {
    workflow_number: 57,
    workflow_name:
      '57 - Core - Human Handoff Orchestrator',
    endpoint: 'clinic/handoff/create',
    method: 'POST',
    payload: {
      clinic_name: ctx.clinic_name,
      session_id: ctx.session_id,
      message_id: ctx.message_id,
      mobile: common.mobile,
      urgency: 'urgent',
      reason:
        safety.block_reason ||
        'urgent_risk_detected',
      patient_message: ctx.content_text || '',
      risk_flags: ctx.message_risk_flags || [],
      confirm_handoff: true,
    },
    required: [
      'clinic_name',
      'session_id',
      'message_id',
      'reason',
    ],
  },

  human_handoff: {
    workflow_number: 57,
    workflow_name:
      '57 - Core - Human Handoff Orchestrator',
    endpoint: 'clinic/handoff/create',
    method: 'POST',
    payload: {
      clinic_name: ctx.clinic_name,
      session_id: ctx.session_id,
      message_id: ctx.message_id,
      mobile: common.mobile,
      urgency: 'normal',
      reason:
        safety.block_reason ||
        'human_review_requested',
      patient_message: ctx.content_text || '',
      risk_flags: ctx.message_risk_flags || [],
      confirm_handoff: true,
    },
    required: [
      'clinic_name',
      'session_id',
      'message_id',
      'reason',
    ],
  },
};

let routeStatus = 'no_tool';
let route = null;
let missingForTool = [];
let payloadReady = false;
let nextAction = 'compose_response';

if (
  [
    'ask_clarification',
    'ask_missing_information',
    'request_confirmation',
  ].includes(safetyDecision)
) {
  routeStatus = 'patient_input_required';
  nextAction = 'compose_response';

} else if (
  safetyDecision === 'response_only' ||
  safeToolAction === 'none'
) {
  routeStatus = 'response_only';
  nextAction = 'compose_response';

} else if (!routeMap[safeToolAction]) {
  routeStatus = 'unsupported_tool';
  nextAction = 'human_handoff';

} else {
  route = routeMap[safeToolAction];

  missingForTool = route.required.filter((field) => {
    const value = route.payload[field];

    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      return value.length === 0;
    }

    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      const allowZero = (
        route.allow_zero_fields || []
      ).includes(field);

      return allowZero
        ? (
            !Number.isFinite(value) ||
            value < 0
          )
        : (
            !Number.isFinite(value) ||
            value <= 0
          );
    }

    if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
      return false;
    }

    if (
      value &&
      typeof value === 'object'
    ) {
      return Object.keys(value).length === 0;
    }

    return !text(value);
  });

  const requiredTrueMissing = (
    route.required_true || []
  ).filter((field) => route.payload[field] !== true);

  const requiredAnyMissing = (
    route.required_any || []
  )
    .filter((group) => {
      if (!Array.isArray(group)) return false;

      return !group.some((field) => {
        const value = route.payload[field];

        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
          return value.length > 0;
        }

        if (typeof value === 'number') {
          return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0;
        }

        if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
          return value === true;
        }

        if (
          value &&
          typeof value === 'object'
        ) {
          return Object.keys(value).length > 0;
        }

        return Boolean(text(value));
      });
    })
    .flat();

  missingForTool = [
    ...new Set([
      ...missingForTool,
      ...requiredTrueMissing,
      ...requiredAnyMissing,
    ]),
  ];

  payloadReady = missingForTool.length === 0;
  routeStatus = payloadReady
    ? 'ready'
    : 'needs_input';

  nextAction = payloadReady
    ? 'execute_routed_workflow'
    : 'compose_missing_tool_information_question';
}

const routingPayload = {
  stage: 'tool_router',
  version: 'tool-router-final-v5',
  routed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  route_status: routeStatus,
  safety_decision: safetyDecision,
  safe_tool_action: safeToolAction,
  target_workflow_number:
    route?.workflow_number ?? null,
  target_workflow_name:
    route?.workflow_name ?? null,
  endpoint: route?.endpoint ?? null,
  method: route?.method ?? null,
  payload: route?.payload ?? {},
  required_fields: route?.required ?? [],
  missing_for_tool: missingForTool,
  payload_ready: payloadReady,
  execution_mode:
    'deferred_until_conversation_orchestrator',
  next_action: nextAction,
};

return [{
  json: {
    success: routeStatus !== 'unsupported_tool',
    result:
      routeStatus === 'ready'
        ? 'tool_route_ready'
        : routeStatus === 'needs_input'
          ? 'tool_route_needs_input'
          : routeStatus === 'unsupported_tool'
            ? 'unsupported_tool_action'
            : 'response_route_ready',

    session_id: Number(ctx.session_id),
    message_id: Number(ctx.message_id),
    clinic_name: ctx.clinic_name,
    patient_name: ctx.patient_name,
    mobile: common.mobile,
    language: ctx.language,
    intent: ctx.intent,
    safety_decision: safetyDecision,
    safe_tool_action: safeToolAction,
    route_status: routeStatus,
    target_workflow_number:
      route?.workflow_number ?? null,
    target_workflow_name:
      route?.workflow_name ?? null,
    endpoint: route?.endpoint ?? null,
    method: route?.method ?? null,
    tool_payload: route?.payload ?? {},
    tool_payload_json: JSON.stringify(
      route?.payload ?? {}
    ),
    required_fields: route?.required ?? [],
    missing_for_tool: missingForTool,
    payload_ready: payloadReady,
    next_action: nextAction,
    routing_payload: routingPayload,
    routing_payload_json: JSON.stringify(
      routingPayload
    ),
  },
}];

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS message_id,
        $3::TEXT AS route_status,
        $4::TEXT AS safe_tool_action,
        $5::JSONB AS routing_payload,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS pending_action
),

updated_message AS (
    UPDATE conversation_messages message

    SET
        tool_action =
            request.safe_tool_action,

        tool_result =
            COALESCE(
                message.tool_result,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'routing',
                request.routing_payload
            )

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE message.id = request.message_id
      AND message.session_id = request.session_id

    RETURNING message.id
),

updated_session AS (
    UPDATE conversation_sessions session

    SET
        pending_action =
            request.pending_action,

        status = CASE
            WHEN request.route_status = 'needs_input'
                THEN 'waiting_patient'

            WHEN request.route_status = 'unsupported_tool'
                THEN 'waiting_human'

            ELSE session.status
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE session.id = request.session_id

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM updated_message
      )

    RETURNING
        session.status,
        session.pending_action
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_message
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_message
        )
            THEN 'message_or_session_not_found'

        WHEN request.route_status = 'ready'
            THEN 'tool_route_saved'

        WHEN request.route_status = 'needs_input'
            THEN 'tool_route_waiting_for_input'

        WHEN request.route_status = 'unsupported_tool'
            THEN 'tool_route_requires_human'

        ELSE 'response_route_saved'
    END AS result,

    request.session_id,
    request.message_id,
    request.route_status,
    request.safe_tool_action,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS session_status,

    (
        SELECT pending_action
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS pending_action

FROM request_data request;

## Tool Router نهایی بیمارمحور

این نسخه جایگزین 81B است.

علاوه بر مسیرهای قبلی، موارد زیر اضافه شده‌اند:
- Workflow 36: پاسخ پیگیری پس از مراجعه
- Workflow 21: تصمیم بیمار در تغییر فوری برنامه پزشک

کنترل جدید:
- pain_level=0 به‌عنوان مقدار معتبر پذیرفته می‌شود.
- برای Reschedule ناشی از Disruption، option_number اجباری است.
- جزئیات Red Flag، مشکل دارویی و شکایت به‌صورت شرطی اجباری می‌شوند.
